purpose: Separate, minimal China macro confirmation. It is not China CLI and cannot vote in any G8 pair frame.

activity.publisher: National Bureau of Statistics of China
activity.pit_requirement: Receipt must retain release timestamp, release-period label, source URL and immutable raw payload hash.

demand.publisher: National Bureau of Statistics of China
demand.series: Total retail sales of consumer goods
demand.pit_requirement: Receipt must retain release timestamp, release-period label, source URL and immutable raw payload hash.

direction_rule.per_series: IMPROVING when current > prior; WEAKENING when current < prior; STABLE when equal; WITHHELD when a strict receipt is missing or invalid.
direction_rule.combined: IMPROVING only when both activity and demand are IMPROVING; WEAKENING only when both are WEAKENING; STABLE only when both are STABLE; otherwise MIXED. Any WITHHELD input makes the combined state WITHHELD.
direction_rule.interpretation: China confirmation is contextual only. MIXED means the China layer provides no directional confirmation to G8 FX; it must never be converted into a mechanical pair vote.

activation_rule: Context-only activation is permitted only when both official releases are independently ingested with strict PIT receipts and the documented direction rule validates. Missing or delayed releases yield WITHHELD, never a synthetic confirmation.
